notes.title: End Level Fix
notes.content: There was a bug with the end level not loading to the credits and ultimately back to the main menu. This patch should correct that issue.

notes.title: Level Reload Bug Fix
notes.content: There was a bug with the level reload mechanic when the player runs out of time. This bug would send players back to the first level, when it should restart the player on the current level. That bug has been patched.

notes.title: Optimization Patch
notes.content: Did a passthrough of all in-game textures. Any 4k textures were scaled down to 2k. Normal and Roughness textures were scaled down to 50% and 25% respectively. This modification lowered the overall file size of the game from 3.95gb to 1.54gb. On my personal machine, I see GPU memory consumption range from 3gb to 4.5gb. This should improve overall performance.
